q: To _____, no one has been able to solve this difficult problem.
explain: date n. 日期（to date 迄今为止）。

q: The old church is believed to _____ back to the twelfth century.
translation: 这座古老的教堂被认为可以追溯至12世纪。

q: The new report adds _____ to the idea that the climate is changing fast.
explain: weight n. 分量、重要性（add weight to 增加……的分量）。

q: The company _____ the answers to give more importance to experienced customers.
explain: weight v. 使……有分量，偏重。
translation: 公司对答案进行了加权，以更重视有经验的客户。

q: There is a strong _____ between the two sisters who grew up together.
translation: 这两个一起长大的姐妹之间有着深厚的纽带。

explain: bond v. 建立亲密关系。
translation: 球队在新赛季前一起度过了一周，以建立亲密关系。

q: She _____ the boat to a post near the river bank.
translation: 她把船系在河岸边的一根柱子上。

translation: 他系了一条蓝色领带去面试，以显得更专业。

q: The two schools _____ students every year to learn about different cultures.
translation: 这两所学校每年交换学生，以了解不同的文化。

q: There was a useful _____ of ideas at the meeting yesterday.
translation: 昨天的会议上进行了有益的思想交流。

q: She looked _____ at the house one last time before leaving.
translation: 离开前，她最后一次回头看了看那所房子。

q: He hurt his _____ while lifting heavy boxes at work.
translation: 他在工作时搬重箱子伤了背部。

q: Her parents _____ her decision to study abroad for a year.
translation: 她的父母支持她出国学习一年的决定。

q: We sat in the _____ seat of the car and said nothing.
translation: 我们坐在汽车后座，什么也没说。

q: Experts questioned the _____ of the painting before it was sold.
translation: 专家在这幅画被售出前质疑它的真实性。

q: This bag is _____, so it costs much more than a copy.
explain: authentic adj. 真实的，真品的。
translation: 这个包是真品，所以它比仿制品贵得多。

q: She is taking the company to court over her unfair _____.
translation: 她因被不公平解雇而将公司告上法庭。

q: The teacher _____ the rumor as a silly joke and continued the lesson.
explain: dismiss v. 对……不予考虑，把……当作……而不屑一顾。
translation: 老师把那个谣言当作愚蠢的玩笑而不予理会，继续上课。

q: Please make an _____ decision after reading all the reports carefully.
explain: informed adj. 有根据的，了解情况的。
translation: 请在仔细阅读所有报告后做出有根据的决定。

q: Please _____ the office if you plan to arrive late tomorrow.
translation: 如果你明天打算晚到，请通知办公室。

q: Students study _____ to learn about shapes, lines, and angles.
translation: 学生学习几何学，以了解形状、线条和角。

q: The garden has a _____ design with straight paths and round ponds.
explain: geometrical adj. 几何的，几何形状的。
translation: 这个花园有几何形状的设计，有笔直的小路和圆形的池塘。

q: The building looks _____ because the left and right sides are the same.
translation: 这座建筑看起来是对称的，因为左右两边完全相同。

q: Her hairstyle is _____, with one side much shorter than the other.
translation: 她的发型不对称，一侧比另一侧短得多。

q: She opened a bank _____ when she started her first full-time job.
translation: 她开始第一份全职工作时开了一个银行账户。

q: The heavy rain may _____ for the small number of people at the event.
translation: 大雨可能是活动现场人数少的原因。

q: Many young readers _____ with the main character in this popular novel.
translation: 许多年轻读者认同这本流行小说中的主角。

q: We took the early _____ to the city to avoid the morning rush.
translation: 我们乘坐早班火车进城，以避开早晨的高峰。

q: He _____ the camera on the birds sitting on the old wall.
translation: 他把相机对准了停在旧墙上的鸟。

q: The _____ for all her hard work came when she won the prize.
translation: 她所有努力得到的回报在她获奖时到来了。

q: Their decision to save money each month _____ off when they bought a house.
explain: pay v. 成功，带来好结果。
translation: 他们每月存钱的决定在他们买房时有了好结果。

q: The job is hard, but the _____ is good enough for him.
translation: 这份工作很辛苦，但报酬对他来说足够好。

q: I try to _____ the gym three times a week after work.
explain: hit v. 去（某地）（hit the gym 去健身房锻炼）。
translation: 我尽量每周下班后去健身房三次。

q: The song was a big _____ and played on the radio all summer.
explain: hit n. 成功而风行一时的事物。
translation: 这首歌是风行一时的热门歌曲，整个夏天都在电台播放。

q: _____ to say, we were very happy to hear the good news.
explain: needless adj. 不必要的（needless to say 不用说）。
translation: 不用说，听到这个好消息我们非常高兴。

q: You should drive with _____ when the roads are wet and icy.
translation: 道路湿滑结冰时，你应该小心驾驶。

q: The doctor _____ him against eating too much salt after the operation.
translation: 医生警告他在手术后不要吃太多盐。

q: She received public _____ for her work in helping poor children.
translation: 她因帮助贫困儿童的工作而得到公众认可。

q: She is in _____ of the whole department while the manager is away.
explain: charge n. 负责、掌管（in charge of 负责）。
translation: 经理不在时，她负责整个部门。

q: The hotel _____ guests extra if they want to use the swimming pool.
translation: 如果客人想使用游泳池，酒店会额外收费。

q: Many people find _____ comfort in music when they feel sad.
explain: spiritual adj. 精神的，心灵的。
translation: 许多人在感到悲伤时从音乐中找到精神安慰。

q: The team showed great _____ even after losing the first two games.
translation: 即使输掉了前两场比赛，这支队伍仍然表现出顽强的精神。

q: The prisoners were _____ away before the guards noticed.
explain: spirit v. 偷偷带走，绑架。
translation: 囚犯们在守卫注意到之前被偷偷带走了。

q: The ball _____ the window and broke the glass.
translation: 球打中了窗户，打碎了玻璃。

q: The _____ lasted for three weeks and caused serious delays.

q: The family had to _____ their home when the river rose quickly.

q: It is hard to _____ between the twins when they wear the same clothes.
translation: 双胞胎穿同样衣服时很难区分。

q: The number of new jobs is a useful _____ of how well the economy is doing.
translation: 新工作的数量是衡量经济表现的一个有用指标。

q: The new coffee blend seems to _____ the sweet spot for many young customers.

translation: 新款咖啡似乎正合许多年轻顾客的口味，恰到好处。

q: The song became a big _____ and was played on every radio station.
explain: hit n. 风行一时的事物，热销品。
translation: 这首歌成为风行一时的热销歌曲，在每个电台播放。

q: The plan to cut costs _____ and made customers much angrier.
explain: backfire v. 事与愿违，产生反效果。
translation: 削减成本的计划事与愿违，让顾客更加愤怒。

q: This machine can _____ very small changes in air pressure.

q: She has years of _____ in teaching young children to read.

q: Many people _____ stress before an important exam or interview.

q: He ran fast to _____ the bus before the doors closed.
explain: catch v. 抓住，接住；赶上。
translation: 他跑得很快，在车门关闭前赶上了公交车。

explain: catch n. 隐藏的问题，圈套。
translation: 这个报价肯定有隐藏的问题，因为听起来太好了。

q: The _____ of housing in this city has risen very quickly.

q: Her latest book has _____ all her earlier works in sales.

translation: 当地方领导人提供良好支持时，小企业能够兴旺发展。

q: The extra traffic _____ to the delay and made us miss the flight.

translation: 我们会审查你的申请，并在适当的时候回复。

q: He finally received the respect that was his _____.
translation: 他终于得到了他应得的尊重。

q: The _____ slept peacefully in her mother's arms.

q: The hospital opened a new unit for _____ care last month.

q: The city went into _____ after the number of cases rose sharply.
